name: mahidol-slcm-evaluator
description: Chrome extension for filling Mahidol SLCM evaluation forms with a selected score.

scripts.check: node --check background.js && node --check portal_script.js && node --check form_script.js && node -e "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('manifest.json', 'utf8'))"
scripts.package: mkdir -p dist && zip -r dist/mahidol-slcm-evaluator.zip manifest.json background.js portal_script.js form_script.js icon16.png icon48.png icon128.png README.md LICENSE PRIVACY.md
